apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Skipping past an exercise counts it as done. An unfinished morning round no longer eats the evening one.
An unfinished morning round no longer eats the evening one: after four hours, Barefoot PT starts a full new round.
Leaving the app no longer pauses: a tap that lands as you swipe out is undone. Diagnostics now say what caused every pause. Evening rounds after BFR include the 30 s holds and calf raise.
